item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：多轮扩散图像编辑复用中间激活可省算力，但跨轮保留激活带来内存/带宽开销；压缩缓存还须支持选择性复用，且编辑请求快于初始生成带来调度难题。

方法：TileCache 压缩感知服务：压缩发生在编辑过程中（避免每请求缓冲超 100GB 激活再压缩），压缩缓存支持未来 masked 编辑只取子集，调度兼顾初始生成与编辑请求。

关键数字：若不压缩感知构建，每请求需缓冲超 100GB 激活。

为什么值得看：扩散多轮编辑的缓存压缩+调度系统，直面真实服务负载的工程挑战。

原文：TileCache: Serving Multi-Round Diffusion Image Editing with Compressed Activation Caches

item.title: Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

几何可学习不变量Transformer的对称性指纹识别

Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. We show how our architecture and the fingerprinting process work in the case of an image classification task.

item.title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

人机协同证据校准的LLM辅助治疗方案判定规模化

Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. 人机协同证据校准的LLM辅助治疗方案判定规模化

Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. item.title: Sample-Efficient Ensemble Reinforcement Learning at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

大规模样本高效集成强化学习

Ensemble methods such as MeanQ have been shown to improve the sample efficiency of relatively small model-free deep reinforcement learning (RL) architectures, including DQN and similarly sized variants such as Rainbow. However, to our knowledge, the effects of ensembling on large-scale architectures such as Bigger Better Faster (BBF) have not been studied. In this work, we present MeanQ-BBF, a hybrid model-free algorithm that combines the principles of MeanQ and BBF. Through statistically rigorous evaluation on the Atari 100K benchmark, we show that in contrast to naive scaling of the network size of BBF, which degrades performance, MeanQ-BBF is able to leverage the increase in model capacity to improve performance over BBF. Moreover, MeanQ-BBF does this in a computationally efficient way by organizing the added parameters into largely independent learners. Finally, we discuss the performance-cost tradeoff in the context of practical sample-efficient RL.

item.title: QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

QA-CMIF：容错sEMG-惯性手势的轻量跨模态潜变量填补融合

Fusing surface electromyography (sEMG) with inertial measurements is widely used for myoelectric prosthesis control and wearable human-machine interfaces. In daily wear, however, socket micro-displacement, electrode lift-off, and wire failures often corrupt an unknown subset of sEMG channels through burst artifacts, lift-off shocks, or open-circuit dropouts. Existing fusion networks mix all channels in the first convolutional layer, so a few corrupted electrodes contaminate the entire latent representation, whereas gate-only attenuation of corrupted channels discards the co-activation cues needed to separate fine-grained gestures. We propose QA-CMIF, a quality-aware cross-modal latent imputation and fusion framework that encodes each sEMG channel independently, scores its reliability with a soft gate, and protects intact channels via a confidence-weighted residual bypass, while a cross-attention imputer repairs degraded channels in latent space using the inertial stream and remaining reliable sEMG channels under a bad-channel alignment loss. item.title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

PISG：扩散组合优化的约束对齐信号放大

Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. Building on this observation, we propose Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG), a training-free method that amplifies these signals at test time. At each denoising step, PISG constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction away from it. item.title: Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

多准确率作为分布漂移学习误差基准

Agnostic learning has a well-developed theory of computational and statistical complexity. For learning with distribution shift, even the choice of an appropriate error benchmark remains challenging. Testable learning with distribution shift (TDS) was introduced to develop computational foundations for this setting: using labeled training data and unlabeled test data, the learner must either produce a predictor with low test error or detect distribution shift. However, standard agnostic TDS guarantees allow a constant-factor amplification of the optimum error even when the training and test distributions coincide. They therefore do not directly recover the guarantee of classical agnostic learning. We introduce shift multiaccuracy, a stronger error benchmark inspired by multiaccuracy from algorithmic fairness. This yields a TDS formulation that becomes equivalent to multiaccuracy when there is no shift. Using a recent nontrivial reduction from agnostic learning to multiaccurate prediction from prior work, we obtain the first TDS framework that formally generalizes agnostic learning through an efficient reduction preserving the training marginal. item.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

多分支Transformer

Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine th…

item.title: Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

Microfitting：缓存测试时训练的持续学习

Continual learning is a promising approach to specialize language models to an organization's private data. However, current methods exhibit a number of drawbacks including catastrophic forgetting, where new training updates overwrite prior knowledge. We present microfitting, which trains and caches a small adapter for each document. Each adapter is trained once, offline, on synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried. This method borrows from test-time learning literature and sidesteps the problem of continual learning through parameter isolation, allowing the system to specialize on new data without overwriting prior knowledge. The process that generates adapter training data also improves over time, revising its recipe from previous outcomes and fresh examples of the target workload. On DeepSeek V4 Flash, microfitting substantially improves accuracy over the base model. In Enterprise Document Operations (EDO), an open-book Q&A environment over real-world enterprise documents, our method achieves a 38.2% relative improvement over base-model performance. item.title: Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

长输出LLM服务中让抢占变得有产出的调度方法

Reasoning LLMs generate long outputs whose key--value (KV) caches occupy GPU memory for minutes. When memory fills, the server preempts requests, and a preempted request can repeatedly lose and recover its state while producing little new output. We call this behavior KV thrashing. In certain cases, existing systems leave more than a fifth of requests stalled for over a minute. Because preemption cannot be avoided without delaying admission, we ask how to make it productive. We present Stint, a serving system that preserves a preempted request's work, bounds how long it waits, and gives it fresh output after it returns. Stint stores fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with an exact-extent allocator, and moves them with fused K/V gather/scatter kernels and double buffering. Age-based readmission brings stalled requests back, and protection gives them a turn of fresh decoding before another preemption. Remaining-length estimates from decoding hidden states guide victim selection. On olympiad-math replays with Qwen3-32B on H200 GPUs, no request pauses for more than 50 seconds under Stint and p99 time per output token falls by 50.7\% relative to recomputation in th…

方法：MIAO 软硬件协同设计，利用 systolic 阵列（如 TPU、Trainium）把累加分布到不同 PE 的特点，按累加阶段定制精度，替代阵列内统一累加精度。

item.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环语言模型（Ouro/Raven）每 token 多次应用同一权重共享块，自回归解码需逐 loop 顺序执行，延迟高。

方法：LoopSkim 让流水线深度本身充当验证器：草稿 token 从上下文复制（类似 prompt lookup）在头几个 loop 后进入，任何后续 readout 与其矛盾就在该深度替换，只有全深度 readout 提交 token；同时固定每次的随机抽取。

关键数字：论文未给出摘要级量化数字（摘要截断）。

为什么值得看：无损多深度投机解码，免去额外验证 pass 的结构性设计精巧。

item.title: LENS: Replacing LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers with Learnable Normalization States
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

LENS：用可学习归一化状态替换Transformer的LayerNorm与Softmax

LayerNorm and attention Softmax are critical operations in Transformers. However, they cannot be efficiently mapped to General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) computations on hardware. Therefore, modern hardware accelerator designs, such as NPUs on ASIC/FPGA, consume a large amount of hardware resources or chip area to implement their specific arithmetic units. Building on previous work about LayerNorm, Softmax, and their alternatives, we introduce Learnable Normalization States (LENS), a framework that reformulates LayerNorm as tiny MLPs by abstracting a common structure from related methods and extends this method to Softmax, which moves more of the computation in Transformers to GEMM as a hardware-friendly architecture. We evaluate LENS on image classification with Vision Transformers (ViT) and autoregressive language modeling with Pythia models, including generalization tests on WikiText and LAMBADA. Across these tasks, LENS matches or exceeds baseline performance in several vision settings and retains most of the baseline performance in the remaining vision and language experiments. These findings may suggest that hand-designed normalization and attention functions are not the on…

item.description:

注意力基础设施多agent强化学习用于高速匝道汇入

On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. item.title: Improving fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

提升图神经网络细粒度表达能力

This thesis investigates the expressive power of neural networks for structured data, focusing on graph neural networks and symmetry-aware architectures. We present four main contributions. First, we characterize the generic expressive power of geometric message-passing neural networks on sparse graphs and introduce EGenNet, an architecture achieving the corresponding guarantees. Second, we use representation theory to characterize linear layers equivariant to multiple permutations, including wreath-product symmetries. Third, we study permutation-invariant set representations that preserve containment, establish dimensional bounds and impossibility results, and introduce MASNet. Finally, we propose FSW-GNN, a message-passing architecture combining strong expressivity and bi-Lipschitz stability guarantees with strong empirical performance on long-range graph-learning tasks. Together, these results provide a broader understanding of how neural architectures can preserve the geometric, algebraic, order-theoretic, and metric structure of their inputs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: How Should Parallel Langevin Chains Share Noise?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

并行Langevin链应如何共享噪声

Parallel Langevin sampling usually draws an array of independent Gaussian vectors, one row per chain. The average row drives the ensemble mean, with variance $1/K$ per coordinate for $K$ chains. Yet the unadjusted Langevin algorithm (ULA) specifies only each row's distribution. Subtracting the column means and rescaling, as in classical antithetic sampling, makes that variance zero. Each chain keeps its ordinary ULA path law for any finite run. For quadratic targets we derive the joint covariance of linear estimates computed from the ensemble mean, including coefficient estimates, time averages and predictions. The identity separates contributions from initial states and Gaussian draws. The coupling changes the second through one scalar, which is zero whenever the draws sum to zero across chains. For nonquadratic targets we bound the remaining variance. Centering has a price: for a quadratic form in the mean-subtracted Gaussian state, the ensemble average has variance $1/(K-1)$ relative to one chain, compared with $1/K$ under independent draws. On three tempered logistic posteriors, eight centered chains reduced the variance of the posterior-mean estimate, summed over coordinates, …

item.title: High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 位居开源 ASR 榜首，但连续 batching 每轮工作量与最优融合粒度都在变，高效服务不止于快算子。

方法：服务引擎在每个 pass 于离线测好的 crossover 处，选择 persistent megakernel 或融合 kernel 链。

关键数字：H100 上精度保持的服务吞吐峰值 4,345× 实时、为调优 vLLM 的 1.39×，低并发最高 4.39×；B200 峰值 6,367×、1.64× vLLM；WER 1.91–1.93%（vLLM 1.88–1.93%）。

为什么值得看：ASR 榜首模型的高吞吐服务，regime-aware 内核选择工程完整、数据充分。

原文：High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion

item.title: HBF-EventLab: A Discrete-Event Simulator for Studying Host-Device Coordination in High Bandwidth Flash
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

研究高带宽闪存主机-设备协调的离散事件模拟器HBF-EventLab

High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) combines NAND flash density with high-bandwidth accelerator connectivity, offering additional memory capacity for large language model inference. However, limited hardware availability makes it difficult to evaluate how host behavior and device resource constraints jointly affect HBF request processing. We present HBF-EventLab, an open-source, transaction-level discrete-event simulator based on the Open Compute Project HBF specification. HBF-EventLab connects host request dispatch, command admission, fragmented write assembly, read dispatch, NAND execution, and completion feedback within a shared event loop. It explicitly models distinct resource lifetimes and separates configurable scheduling policies from ordering and resource constraints, enabling controlled exploration of host-device coordination. Experiments show how resource limits, address interleaving, fragment arrival patterns, and scheduling policies affect write completion and request latency. The results highlight the need to consider resource limits and scheduling policies jointly, accounting for their interactions with write assembly and read eligibility. We also integrate HBF-EventLab with …

item.title: GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：编译器 pass 选择通常靠固定流水线（-O2/-O3）或手写启发式——能否用 GNN 单次前向选择 pass 序列？

方法：GraphPass 用图注意力（GAT）或图卷积（GCN）编码程序 CFG，分类到五种 pass 序列之一；在 5,000 个合成 CFG、五个程序族上评估，并做边消融实验。

关键数字：两种编码器对 held-out 程序约 92% 与参考标签一致；手写规则启发式仅 68.4%、flat MLP 85%；消融表明增益来自逐块处理而非 CFG 边。

为什么值得看：编译器 pass 选择的 GNN 实证，并厘清「图结构 vs 逐块特征」的贡献来源。

原文：GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection

item.title: GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

GNN深度强化学习用于极端水位海岸应急响应

When a storm surge approaches a coastal town, the emergency plan must be put into action quickly using water-level forecasts, flood extent, road access, vulnerable residents and shelters. Bringing this information together under time pressure is slow and depends on the duty officer's expertise. This paper is one step in a wider research line from data to safe decisions: machine learning to understand the hazard, reinforcement learning and planning to choose actions, large language models (LLMs) to explain and cross-check them, and an assurance layer that keeps people in charge. Here we address the action step on a real place. We ask whether a policy can learn the timing of emergency actions from decades of real events. Lido di Venezia is represented as a heterogeneous graph built from public elevation, road, building and census data and driven by hourly tide-gauge records from 1983 to 2024, with seven actions taken from the municipal emergency plan. A PPO policy is trained on this graph and compared, on storm windows unseen in training, with a rule-based system simulating the officer's discretionary decisions. On 18 historical test scenarios, PPO achieves a similar reduction in pop…

item.title: Federated Dataset Simulation: Inducing Label-Free Heterogeneity Across Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

联邦数据集模拟：跨任务诱导无标签异质性

Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across decentralized clients without sharing raw data. While the field has seen rapid growth, the datasets underpinning FL evaluation have not kept pace: real federated datasets remain scarce, and most studies rely on small-scale centralized classification datasets partitioned via Dirichlet label skew, a one-dimensional proxy for the multi-dimensional heterogeneity present in real federations. Moreover, label-based partitioning is by construction inapplicable to non-classification tasks such as segmentation and detection, for which no principled simulation method exists. We cast the conversion of centralized datasets into federated benchmarks as the task of Federated Dataset Simulation (FDS), and decompose it into a representation function $Φ$ and an assignment mechanism $π$. We provide two label-free instantiations -- geometric partitioning via pretrained model embeddings and semantic partitioning via vision-language model-derived criteria -- applicable to classification and dense prediction tasks alike. We evaluate across four datasets spanning classification, segmentation, and detection, and show that both methods induce he…

item.title: Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

生成式推荐模型中强化学习探索

Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded fo…

item.title: Exhaustive Evaluation of Fixed-Point Reciprocal Architectures for FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：FPGA 定点倒数（用于归一化与除法）共享输出格式但最坏误差与资源需求各异——表宽、内部精度与细化如何权衡？

方法：对 Q16.16 与 Q8.24 格式穷举评估：0.5–2.5 区间每个可表示输入对照精确整数参考；从 RTL 重建五条算术路径，评估 guarded interpolation、Newton-Raphson 细化与残差校正，对照多项式与数字递推基线。

关键数字：全部 131,073 个 Q16.16 与 33,554,433 个 Q8.24 输入验证正确舍入。

为什么值得看：FPGA 定点倒数架构的穷举级评估，正确舍入全覆盖验证，工程参考价值高。

原文：Exhaustive Evaluation of Fixed-Point Reciprocal Architectures for FPGAs

item.title: Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

昂贵目标嵌入的精确稀疏分配：固定实现证书

Embedding-based one-to-one association is common in vision and data integration: detections are associated with tracks and records are linked across databases. Such pipelines often solve a sparse optional assignment whose edge scores add a cheap term to an inner product of neural embeddings. When target embeddings are costly, one can acquire them selectively and stop once a certificate proves that the current assignment is optimal. We give such a certificate for unit-norm embeddings. It bounds the unknown part of every reassignment by a support function and maximizes the resulting robust gains with a second sparse assignment; a shared owner-centred bound dominates any fixed-centre triangle bound. We make precise what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant: the realized values of the acquired rows and every unit-ball completion of the rest, not a second forward pass in a different batch. Auditing against a separately batched cache tests a different property; on our first pilot it produced a spurious $2.49\times10^{-6}$ objective failure. We audit the corrected protocol on four public text entity-matching benchmarks with two frozen encoders; no image data is used.…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Evaluating Near-Perfect Accuracy Claims in Machine-Learning-Based Leak Detection for Two-Phase Pipelines: A Condition-Blocked Audit
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

机器学习泄漏检测近完美精度主张的评估

Reliable leak detection in gas-liquid two-phase pipelines is important for process safety, yet machine-learning studies frequently report near-perfect performance using evaluation protocols that may not represent deployment to unseen operating conditions. This study audits a pressure-based leak-detection model using condition-blocked leave-one-condition-out validation, in which the classifier is tested on a flow condition excluded from training. Accuracy decreased from 93.3% under within-condition evaluation to 59.1% across fifteen unseen-condition tests. Ablation analysis showed that most of this difference arose from the data-splitting protocol, with a smaller contribution from encoding operating conditions as model inputs. Under condition-blocked evaluation, the false-alarm and missed-detection rates increased to 34.1% and 10.2%, respectively, demonstrating that near-perfect reported accuracy did not translate into reliable operation at unseen flow conditions. The reduction persisted across all evaluated classifiers, indicating that it was caused by the evaluation design rather than a particular model architecture. Grouped evaluation of an independent acoustic pipeline dataset p…

item.title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

用LLM从医院价格透明度数据估算门诊价格

Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. item.title: Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

通过未来研究方向选择引出LLM研究品味

Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 3…

item.title: Does synthetic pre-training pay off on a microcontroller? Accuracy, latency and energy across two MCUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：渲染图像标注便宜，但 MCU 分类器必须过 INT8 量化并在芯片上正确运行——合成预训练到底值不值？

方法：5 个模型（MobileNetV2@224px 到 61K 参数 CNN）在六类场景数据集上，带/不带合成阶段微调，部署到 ESP32-S3 与 RP2040 实测。

关键数字：全量真实数据下合成阶段无可检测增益；主部署模型 INT8 差 +0.312pp，区间低于源研究重算的 +1.6pp；10% 真实数据时 CNN 获益 +3.438pp（单 seed）、三 seed 平均 +2.715pp。

为什么值得看：MCU 场景合成数据的严谨端到端实证，量化与部署全链路验证。

原文：Does synthetic pre-training pay off on a microcontroller? Accuracy, latency and energy across two MCUs

item.title: Decode Early, Verify Late: Streaming Offline Speech Recognizers Without Accuracy Loss
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

早解码晚验证：无精度损失的流式离线语音识别器

Voice agents need accurate transcripts soon after a user stops speaking. We propose Decode Early, Verify Late (DEVL), a training-free framework for streaming inference with offline ASR models. The server keeps partial transcripts as drafts and verifies the latest against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end. Under stated input and decoding conditions, the final equals the model's greedy offline output in exact arithmetic. We adapt DEVL to four model families. In our five-recognizer comparison, 95-100% of final transcripts are byte-identical to the offline transcripts, WER stays within 0.13 points of offline, and single-stream time to final falls 1.5-7.3x. Serving Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on one A100, DEVL returns finals a median 22-26 ms after turn end at up to 64 streams, 2.7-3.9x sooner than the official streaming mode. It is the only system we tested that meets a 100 ms p99 target, up to 80 streams on Pipecat-STT and 64 on WildASR.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

数据归因应引导预训练

Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Communication-Efficient Distributionally Robust Federated Averaging with Multi-Source Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

多源数据通信高效分布鲁棒联邦平均

Federated learning trains a shared model from distributed client data. The deployment risk is typically specified through two approximations: each unknown local distribution is replaced by its empirical distribution, and the unknown deployment mixture across clients is replaced by empirical or prescribed training weights. Existing robust methods usually address one approximation at a time through local distributional ambiguity sets or worst-case client mixtures. However, joint treatment of both approximations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct a global ambiguity set formed by admissible mixtures of client-wise Wasserstein ambiguity sets, yielding a distributionally robust optimization formulation. The construction allows client-dependent ambiguity radii, preserves client-wise separability of the objective function, and yields a high-probability out-of-sample guarantee for the resulting robust problem. We then introduce a penalty-based approximation of this formulation and develop a communication-efficient algorithm called BiDRO-FedAvg, for which we establish a convergence guarantee. We validate the proposed framework through a market-demand prediction simulati…

item.title: CleanRoute: Reconciling DRC Compliance, Post-Layout Performance, and Runtime in Analog Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

协调DRC合规、布线后性能与运行时的模拟布线CleanRoute

Automated analog routing remains a long-standing challenge because design-rule checking (DRC) compliance, post-layout performance preservation, and runtime reduction are difficult to achieve together. Existing analog routers have limited coverage of joined-metal design rules, lack control over topology-induced mismatch, and face a trade-off between DRC violations and runtime on uniform routing grids. In this paper, we introduce CleanRoute, an analog router that reconciles these three targets. Hierarchical rule enforcement assigns DRC checks and repairs to stages where the required geometry is complete, covering rules both between separate metal and where metal joins. IR-drop isolation constructs supply trees from current-mirror relationships and device currents to reduce topology-induced mismatch that geometric matching cannot eliminate and voltage drops along high-current paths. A flush-line grid adds net-specific lines aligned with device-metal edges to a coarse routing grid, providing DRC-compliant connections without uniform refinement. Experiments on ten operational transconductance amplifiers (OTAs) in a commercial 40nm process show that CleanRoute produces DRC-clean and func…

item.title: Beyond Service Discovery: Coverage Awareness in LLM-Driven Service Composition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

LLM驱动服务组合中超越服务发现的覆盖感知方法

Large language models increasingly support the automated discovery and composition of services. In federated data ecosystems, this creates new opportunities for reusing existing data products and transformation services when constructing service-based data exchange modeled as data-sharing pipelines. However, finding relevant reusable assets does not imply that the available assets are sufficient to satisfy a consumer request. In this paper, we distinguish reuse discovery, the ability to identify relevant published assets, from reuse coverage, the extent to which the available assets support the transformations required by a request. We further consider coverage awareness, the ability of a composition system to recognize insufficient coverage. We investigate this distinction using PipeFinder, an LLM-driven framework for composing data-sharing pipelines, and evaluate 99 consumer requests against a fixed catalogue of data products and transformation services. Our experiments show that relevant data products can be discovered reliably, while successful composition remains considerably more difficult. item.title: Benchmarking LLM Inference on Desktop-Scale NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：两台 DGX Spark GB10 以 200GbE 直连可服务更大模型、提升推理容量，但收益取决于部署方式。

方法：在单台与双台 RDMA 互联系统上，用 vLLM 基准测试 17 个开源权重（8B–235B、dense/MoE、四种权重精度），对比 TP=2、PP=2 与双副本基线，并发 1–64，每配置三次独立启动。

关键数字：TP=2 中位峰值吞吐增益 1.59×（PP=2 为 1.39×），93/96 组匹配比较中更高；空载 token 间延迟降至单台的 0.52–0.73×。

为什么值得看：桌面级双机集群的实测基准，为小集群 TP/PP 选型提供可靠数据。

原文：Benchmarking LLM Inference on Desktop-Scale NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Clusters

item.title: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-15　分类：论文PDF

语言模型训练与推理的相图

A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution of the flows with a discrete Langevin equation, we find that the difference between the inference flows of untrained runs and those of trained models reduces to whether the effective force on the flows in this region is of saddle or stable-node type.…

item.title: Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

预训练地质知识条件LLM的测井重建

Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional adversarial modules. Transferring the coupling mechanism to six conventional deep learning models improves their $R^2$ by 0.0162--0.0789 with cross-well stability. These results demonstrate how foundation-model domain reasoning can constrain deep gene…

item.title: Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

理解预训练中推理数据的作用

Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data during pretraining.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

LLM引导AutoML搜索中critic的安全性研究

LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) > β$, not a deployment certificate. How: a simple observable validation gate and a learned detector can reduce realized loss, but neither is guaranteed to preserve the full-budget no-critic baseline. item.title: Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

测试时约束感知扩散预测控制

Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification. We approximately sample the adapted distribution using the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm in the Gaussian noise space of the pretrained diffusion sampler.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

冻结扩散生成器的局部逆几何频谱转向

A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobserved-pixel PSNR over Adam by 3.25 dB at equal total derivative traversals. Together, the analysis and controls connect request-dependent geometry to directional gains and establish where these gains translate into downstream performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

SMELL：长上下文LLM的稀疏感知内存高效联邦微调

Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. Experiments on OPT-350M and LLaMA2-7B demonstrate that SMELL reduces peak memory consumption by up to 88.35% compared with conventional fine-tuning and 13.25% compared with forward-only LoRA fine-tuning at a 16K context length. Furthermore, SMELL improves fine-tuning performance under certain non-IID settings and supports compact update transmission with progressive re…

item.title: SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

结构化线性动力学用于外生输入预测SLiDE

Accurate time series forecasting with exogenous inputs is critical across domains, including energy and retail, yet modern deep learning models often overfit to correlations that do not generalize under shifts in these inputs. We propose SLiDE, a Koopman-inspired architecture for forecasting with exogenous inputs that imposes structure on latent temporal dynamics. SLiDE approximates nonlinear system evolution using a learned linear operator in a latent space, combining (i) a history encoder that reconstructs the current latent state from past targets and inputs with (ii) a shared linear rollout driven by future exogenous variables. By enforcing a common linear recurrence across encoding and prediction, SLiDE aligns how past information is encoded with how future states evolve, reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations in the input history. Empirically, SLiDE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on real-world benchmarks, including electricity price forecasting and retail demand, while maintaining a computational footprint comparable to lightweight MLP architectures. SLiDE is especially effective at generalizing to shifted exogenous inputs, reducing MSE…

item.title: Run, Read Back, Refine: Observation Fidelity in Execution-Grounded EDA Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

执行接地EDA agent中观察保真度的run-readback-refine研究

Design engineers lose the most time orchestrating flows and patching the gaps where closed EDA tools refuse to interoperate. We present an execution-grounded LLM agent for PyAether, SKILL, and Tcl that closes a generate-execute-refine loop over unified MCP tools (API retrieval, documentation, sandbox execution) and is already deployed in production EDA flows, with a grounding-gap framework positing that EDA-scripting correctness is bottlenecked by observation fidelity at the L4 (situated) layer, which model scale alone cannot reach. On EDA-Scripting-Bench (449 tasks, three languages, four commercial runtimes), the system reaches 76.5% pooled Pass@1 versus 19.7% (pure LLM): the system-level observation axis spans 56.8 percentage points with the model fixed, exceeding the 23.3-percentage-point backbone range with the harness fixed---two axes answering different questions; observation is an under-invested axis whose returns are measurable and graded.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

视觉证据如何改变VLM顾问的激励驱动误报

Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. Adding the true value as text to the image prompt removed the gap in every model. For InternVL3 the gap vanished on scenes it read correctly when it wrote its reading first; for Gemma 3 it persisted. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

残差增强众包分析学习机制用于分布式持续服务构建

Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invariance for distributed continual service construction. Inspired by the success of ResNet, we develop gradient-free residual blocks for ReCALM with closed-form solutions. To implement distributed continual training for ReCALM, we further devise a cross…

item.description:

随机割森林、博弈与近似嵌套各向异性局部几何上的扩散

Just as the data in a dynamic stream changes, questions asked of the stream also change in intent: what to hold constant, which counterfactuals to consider, and so forth. Energy-based learning has been celebrated for its uniform approach to losses and estimation, but interpretability remains challenging. Tree-based methods, on the other hand, offer high interpretability but often rely on bespoke, disjointed estimators. Neither paradigm readily supports changing questions on streaming data. In this paper we take a step towards combining energy, interpretability, and streaming. Random cut forests retain an evolving geometry of the data. We study this geometry as the basis for diffusion dynamics, prediction, explanation, and games. We show that several existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on the trees. The induced affinity is realized exactly by a sparse electrical network on each tree, giving a single energy calculus, a Hamiltonian, maintained along one path per update. This connects an estimate, its supporting evidence, and the response to intervention through the same boxes, gaps, masses, and paths. Different questions correspond to different clamp decisions on …

We introduce PBit1, a finite-control representation of pretrained neural networks that assigns one programmable p-bit to each learned parameter. A 12-bit command sets its probability, a shared affine range maps that probability to the weight domain, and temporal observations reconstruct the weight for inference. Operator-aware range grouping and sensitivity-based sampling allocation adapt the representation to the network. Across five independent weight draws at 32,768 observations per scalar, selected configurations preserve task quality in GPT-2, DistilBERT, and LFM3-1.7B with every learned scalar converted and no fine-tuning. GPT-2 and LFM3 perplexity increase by approximately 0.66% and 0.26%, respectively, while DistilBERT accuracy changes from 87.51% to 87.49%. A sensitivity-based policy reduces GPT-2 reconstruction observations by 41.7% while retaining the quality criterion. Complete-model evaluations reuse reconstructed weights in BF16 inference, and THRML operator experiments examine native sampling and spatial-temporal tradeoffs. Together, these results establish PBit1 as a concrete construction for studying finite-control weight representation and temporal reconstruction …

item.title: On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

on-policy蒸馏作为后门传播通道

On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. However, whether this process also transfers latent security risks from teacher models to student models remains insufficiently studied. In this work, we reveal a new security risk in which an attacker first implants a conditional backdoor into the teacher model through supervised fine tuning (SFT), after which OPD can transfer the backdoor to the student model with only an extremely small proportion of trigger prompt exposure. More concerningly, we find that such backdoor transfer is substantially stronger under OPD than under conventional distillation methods, suggesting that OPD may provide an efficient channel for propagating backdoors across models. Our mechanistic analysis shows that the backdoor signal is primarily transmitted through anomalous differences in the conditional probabilities produced by the teacher model for triggered and clean inputs, and is gradually internalized into the internal representations of the student model during training. item.title: NetBreaker: Benchmarking Network Dismantling across Objectives, Scales, and Toplogoies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

NetBreaker：跨目标/规模/拓扑的网络瓦解基准

Network dismantling seeks to fragment a network with as few node removals as possible, which is widely applied in vulnerability analysis, epidemic containment, and infrastructure protection. Although learning-based methods have become increasingly prominent, their progress remains difficult to assess because existing studies differ in method coverage, datasets, evaluation criteria, and experimental protocols. Thus, we introduce NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark designed for the learning era of network dismantling. NetBreaker organizes 30 methods (18 non-learning and 12 learning-based) under a common taxonomy and evaluates them on 185 networks from eight unified domains, ranging from 14 to 1.69 million nodes. To enable fair comparison, heterogeneous method outputs are converted into node removal sequences and assessed under a unified execution protocol. The evaluation covers four complementary dimensions: target-based effectiveness, trajectory-based effectiveness, structural diagnostics, and applicability & computational efficiency. Extensive experiments show that current learningbased methods do not consistently outperform strong non-learning approaches, while exposing substant…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环 Transformer 靠重复应用同一层提升参数效率，但自回归解码每生成一个 token 需多次顺序过层，解码延迟高。

item.title: Knowledge-Guided Local-to-Global Anomaly Learning for Longitudinal Medication Trajectories
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

知识引导的纵向用药轨迹局部到全局异常学习

Detecting suspicious deviations in longitudinal medication trajectories requires distinguishing knowledge-consistent treatment variations from anomalous changes and linking local deviations to account-level decisions. We propose a knowledge-guided local-to-global (L2G) anomaly learning framework that addresses both challenges. It constructs proxy supervision at three granularities: medication occurrences, treatment episodes, and contiguous visit segments. Knowledge-consistent medication and episode replacements provide plausible negatives, while cross-category and cross-account perturbations provide suspicious proxies. A medication-multiset encoder and causal visit-sequence encoder feed a shared scoring head that produces visit-level anomaly logits. Top-\(α\) aggregation derives account-level scores from these logits, while account-level classification and class-balanced visit-localization objectives jointly optimize the same visit-level evidence. Experiments on two city cohorts compare L2G with native and proxy-adapted anomaly methods. On City-A, L2G outperforms the strongest comparators. Cross-city results show more consistent gains in localization than in account-level detection…

item.title: How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

微调能买多少确定性：边界正则化对抗批次诱导token翻转

Greedy decoding at zero temperature is widely assumed to be deterministic, although the exact same prompt may yield different tokens depending on the number of other prompts sharing the batch for inference. The currently available solutions operate during inference, trading determinism for throughput. Can we train a model in such a way that fewer decoding steps would be susceptible? We characterize the perturbation empirically across six model families and three numerical precisions and observe two empirical facts about the measurement: the perturbation depends exactly on the representable precision (8.00x for bfloat16 vs float16, 8192.0x for float16 vs float32, in line with predictions based on mantissa bits) and the batch invariance happens accidentally at certain tensor shapes, allowing a practitioner to achieve zero nondeterminism merely by setting the sequence length. Then we apply hinge penalization of the model's top-1 / top-2 logit gap, scaled to twice the measured noise quantile. On GSM8K dataset it leads to a 35% reduction in token flips and divergence from 53.8% to 38.1%, at the cost of 1.3 - 2.9 accuracy points, increasing monotonically with the margin size. It does not…

item.title: Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

Func-JEPA：学习函数Sobolev空间作为潜向量

Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than the compared symbolic-regression methods, whereas computer algebra and task-specific models remain stronger on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Federated versus Centralized PV Capacity-Factor Forecasting: A Non-Inferiority Study Across Seven Stations in North Macedonia
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

联邦与集中式光伏容量因子预测非劣性研究

Background: Photovoltaic (PV) forecasts inform energy commitments by PV operators and aggregators and guide charge-discharge scheduling in solar-plus-storage systems. Federated learning enables collaborative model training through model updates when local operators cannot pool raw operational data. This study evaluated whether federated training was non-inferior to centralized training for PV capacity-factor prediction across seven stations in North Macedonia. A common multilayer perceptron was used in an offline forecasting comparison with a 24-hour timestamp lag. Exploratory validation compared local, centralized, Federated Averaging, and Federated Proximal (FedProx) training. FedProx (E = 1, mu = 1) was selected for a confirmatory comparison under a protocol fixed before test evaluation. The comparison used past-only offline inputs, five paired training seeds, macro-averaged mean absolute error (MAE), a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 0.005, and a paired day bootstrap with 10,000 repetitions over 49 test dates. Results: FedProx achieved a macro-MAE of 0.128397, compared with 0.133405 for centralized training. The paired difference (FedProx minus centralized) was -0.005008…

item.title: Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

leave-one-out transformer赋能掩码扩散模型自纠正

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better …

item.title: Efficient and Accurate Causal Validation of Training Data Attribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

训练数据归因的高效准确因果验证

Causal validation of training data attribution (TDA) methods is costly, since evaluation involves retraining a model on many different subsets of the original training set. For example, the Linear Datamodeling Score (LDS), which has become a standard metric for evaluating TDA methods, measures the correlation between TDA predictions and expected retrained model outputs. In this paper, we reduce the amount of computation needed to estimate the LDS along three axes: the number of sampled training subsets, the number of retraining seeds per subset, and the number of models in the attribution ensemble. Each of these factors induces a form of bias in the LDS estimation, and removing these sources of bias significantly reduces the number of retrainings needed to match the same accuracy in LDS estimation. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy of ordinary Spearman using $96$ subsets, measured against a 300-subset reference. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, BERT/QNLI and GPT-2/WikiText-2, estimating the training-noise variance allows us to reproduce the standard five-seed LDS at the same accuracy wit…

item.title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

DynaDFlash：块扩散投机器的动态特征投影

DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

DynaDFlash：块扩散投机器的动态特征投影

DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

item.title: Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

预训练优化器收益能否迁移到KL蒸馏

Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. These results suggest that pretraining optimizer gains do not transfer automatically to KL distillation and should be re-established for the target objective and systems regime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DT-MATCH: Defect- and Topology-Aware Chiplet Matching for Yield Optimization in Heterogeneous Integration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

缺陷与拓扑感知的chiplet匹配，异构集成良率优化

Heterogeneous integration (HI) and advanced packaging enable chiplet-based system-on-chip (SoC) designs; however, they also introduce new yield challenges arising from manufacturing defects and complex die-to-die (D2D) interconnect constraints. In particular, lane-level defects, limited spares, and strict structural compatibility requirements impede the efficient assembly of functional systems from defective but repairable chiplets. We present DT-MATCH, a defect- and topology-aware chiplet matching framework that maximizes the number of functional SoCs under realistic assembly constraints. DT-MATCH provides two complementary approaches. The integer linear programming (ILP)-based approach is implemented using a batching strategy to approximate the exact formulation. The greedy randomized adaptive search procedure (GRASP)-based approach provides substantial acceleration, but it does not guarantee yield optimality. Both approaches use a preprocessing pipeline to reduce the problem size. Experimental results on industrial designs demonstrate that, as expected, the ILP-based approach achieves superior solution quality. The GRASP-based approach leads to lower runtimes while still achievi…

item.title: Compiling Imperative Hardware Protocol Specifications to Hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

将命令式硬件协议规范编译为硬件

Correct modular composition in hardware depends on interfaces with subtle multi-cycle timing behavior, yet such protocols remain difficult to specify, test, and debug. Recent work has demonstrated that hardware communication specifications can take the form of compact imperative programs that describe the cycle-by-cycle behavior of each logical transaction. However, prior tools only use these specifications for simulation-based testing and debugging, and their semantics remain informal. In this work, we develop a theory of hardware protocol specifications using automata. In addition to making the specifications' meaning precise, the automaton representation lets us compile them into synthesizable hardware. We implement a compiler that produces RTL modules for driving hardware interfaces and for reconstructing logical transactions from low-level I/O signals. We demonstrate a variety of use cases for synthesizable protocol drivers and reconstructors, including runtime monitors that check security properties in the Wishbone protocol and a binding generator that synthesizes interfaces between RTL modules and programs in the Calyx intermediate language.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

系统研究agentic LLM编写OpenMP/HPX/StarPU/TTG任务型并行代码的能力

Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. Model capability dominates the outcome: three models produce correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of the cases, while two models rarely compile their own code and almost never succeed. For the capable models, OpenMP Tasking and HPX are handled most reliably, StarPU is close behind, and TTG trails. The best generated GEMM and factorization kernels match or exceed the multithr…

item.title: Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

AI作物产量预测的全球评估基准

Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. Across multiple crops and countries, feature-engineered machine learning and tabular foundation models achieve the strongest overall predictive performance. Data-driven models reduce NRMSE in 72% of countries growing maize and 78% of countries growing wheat, with median reductions of 8.8% and 11.9%, respectively. Across all modeling paradigms, spatial …

item.title: Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

Bellman残差括约：解决折扣与平均奖励RL样本复杂度

We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-γ)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/δ))$ samples, where $S, A, γ, δ$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/δ))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. Our main technical contribution is a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique which improves the efficiency of prior absorbing-MDP-based concentration analyses.

item.title: Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

描述派生状态中小语言模型的名称信息

The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patch and the similarity measure, and weak under single-position patching at 50% depth. H2' (description-paraphrase consistency of name-free states not lower in failure items) is mixed: the SmolLM2 deficit test is significant under the pre-registered sp…

item.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-14　分类：论文PDF

深度循环语言模型的架构与KV重放

Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iter…
